## About
Alltronics Appliances & HVAC is based in Sunrise. Owner Jerry and technicians like Jerome and Conrad come to your home and get your appliances working again.
Neighbors have called us for refrigerators, gas dryers and disposals. We're rated 4.7 from 56 Google reviews, and we're glad to be the people folks call when something in the kitchen or laundry room stops working.

## Services
- Refrigerator: If your fridge has stopped working, we'll come take a look and get it running again.
- Gas dryer: We look into the problem, explain it and tell you the cost before starting the work.
- Kitchen appliances: From the fridge to the disposal, we help with the appliances you use every day.
